comment: Read from the maker's source at commit f086c41, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0; four commits carry that version and src/ is byte-identical across all four, and the installed plugin.json matches f086c41's tag list exactly. Inputs 5 (T input) and 6 (Sync clock) are configured in the module but no PortWidget is added for them, so no cable can reach them; T input would replace the counter with the patched voltage times 2048 and Sync clock is read nowhere at all. MONO is centred on -5V, not on zero: line 390 scales a -1 to +1 signal by 10 and then subtracts 5, giving -15V to +5V, and LEFT and RIGHT inherit the same offset scaled by their gains. Rate CV replaces the RATE knob rather than adding to it, which the README's parameter list does not say. The A, B and C knobs, their attenuverters and their CV jacks carry no lettering on the panel; the names used here are the maker's own parameter names. The equation ranges the maker once computed per program are commented out at lines 354 to 374, so all three knobs run 0 to 15 whichever program is selected. The module has no context menu of its own.
